app.name: CIQ Digital
app.description: Internal Beiersdorf backend for the Cosmetic Ingredient Questionnaire: cases, scope runs, department review tracks, RMES, versioned configuration and a hash-chained audit. Suppliers work only in the separate portal.

architecture.description: Internal Beiersdorf backend for the Cosmetic Ingredient Questionnaire: cases, scope runs, department review tracks, RMES, versioned configuration and a hash-chained audit. Suppliers work only in the separate portal.

mechanism_selection.note: No Case/Board flows (brd L258). Every multi-actor lifecycle is a Process; the process mechanism supports role-assigned, conditional steps with per-step field permissions.

roles.name: CIQ Safety Reviewer

roles.name: CIQ QM Reviewer

roles.name: CIQ Microbiology Reviewer

roles.name: CIQ Sustainability Reviewer

roles.name: CIQ Safety Approver
roles.rationale: Owns "Final decision – Safety" (brd L595).

roles.name: CIQ Regulatory Approver
roles.rationale: Owns "Final decision – Regulatory" (brd L596).

roles.name: CIQ Customs
roles.rationale: Informed department: reads, writes internal notes (brd L588, L649; AS-07).

roles.name: CIQ Legal
roles.rationale: Informed department: reads, writes internal notes (brd L588, L649; AS-07).

roles.name: CIQ Overall Approver

roles.name: CIQ Business Admin

roles.name: CIQ Config Approver

roles.name: CIQ Auditor
roles.rationale: Reads everything incl. the audit chain (brd L253, L650, L715).

roles.name: CIQ Process Owner
roles.rationale: Read-only, shares the Auditor grant column (brd L634; open question 52 default).

roles.name: CIQ Case Sync
roles.rationale: Overlay group (all reviewers, both approvers, RMM) that owns "Part 2 – Beiersdorf review" so whoever finishes the last track runs G5 (brd L59, L600, L622).

roles.name: CIQ Case Admin
roles.rationale: Overlay group (RMM leads): flow Admin on CIQ Case and CIQ Review Track only, for the cancellation cascade (brd L571, L657).

roles.name: CIQ Integration Service
roles.rationale: Identity the integrations act as (I-1..I-6); K-09 decides whether membership is needed (brd L622, L782).

flows.name: CIQ Supplier
flows.description: Supplier company, the isolation unit; holds external keys for SAP MDG and Teamcenter.
flows.rationale: Master data of record, no routing (brd L227, L473).

flows.name: CIQ Supplier Contact
flows.description: Supplier person; Contact_Email is the join key to the portal user.
flows.rationale: Master data of record (brd L228, L474).

flows.name: CIQ Supplier Site
flows.description: Manufacturer or production site of a supplier.
flows.rationale: Master data of record (brd L229, L475).

flows.name: CIQ Raw Material
flows.description: Raw material identity and external keys (BDF, IRMA, Teamcenter, SAP).
flows.rationale: Master data of record (brd L230, L476).

flows.name: CIQ Case Contact
flows.description: Authoritative per-case access list of supplier contacts.
flows.rationale: Register row per case x contact; no routing (brd L231, L477).

flows.name: CIQ Config Version
flows.description: One row per version of each configuration kind, incl. the Release bundle a case pins.
flows.rationale: Versioned config as data; the four-eyes lifecycle lives on A8, Draft-only editing is a convention (brd L232, L421).

flows.name: CIQ Section Definition
flows.description: Copy-on-write render definition of one questionnaire section revision.
flows.rationale: Config data of record (brd L233, L438).

flows.name: CIQ Config Release
flows.description: Four-eyes approval of a configuration release; the frozen anchor of every published hash.
flows.rationale: Multi-actor approval (Business Admin -> Config Approver) and native freeze at End (brd L234, L440, L442).

flows.name: CIQ Case
flows.description: Internal case hub and lifecycle; contract flow for the portal integrations I-1, I-3, I-6.
flows.rationale: Work handed between RMM, Case Sync, integrations and Overall Approver with conditional steps (brd L59, L235, L558-L567).

flows.name: CIQ Case Index
flows.description: Listable read model: one lane row per case x cycle x (Case or department).
flows.rationale: Listable single-writer lanes because non-admins cannot list process items (brd L236, L370-L372; T5).

flows.name: CIQ Scope Run
flows.description: One immutable rule-engine run: inputs, versions, full result incl. N.A., additions only.
flows.rationale: Write-once register (brd L237, L390; v2 override 2).

flows.name: CIQ Component
flows.description: K2.1 composition: one typed row per component, analysable without opening a document.
flows.rationale: Typed register written at intake (brd L240, L393).

flows.name: CIQ Document
flows.description: One row per uploaded file (File_Name, Uploaded_At, Uploaded_By); additive, no versions.
flows.rationale: Append-only register (brd L45-L48, L241, L394).

flows.name: CIQ Review Track
flows.description: One department review subprocess per case cycle; only the activated department gets a task.
flows.rationale: Department step owned by a static role, conditional on Dept_Gate, plus SAF/REG decision steps (brd L61, L242, L404, L590-L597).

flows.name: CIQ Open Point
flows.description: Internal twin of a portal query: justification, responsible user, internal due date, outcome.
flows.rationale: Mirror register; the authority is the portal query step (brd L243, L398, L400).

flows.name: CIQ RMES Record
flows.description: One RMES per case cycle, created with Case_Code + timestamp.
flows.rationale: Register row created at intake (brd L51, L244, L408).

flows.name: CIQ RMES Safety Result
flows.description: Safety criterion results (current-state rows); editable by Safety only.
flows.rationale: Per-department register so grants enforce REQ-CFG-004 (brd L245, L409; plan D13).

flows.name: CIQ RMES Regulatory Result
flows.description: Regulatory criterion results (current-state rows); editable by Regulatory only.
flows.rationale: Per-department register so grants enforce REQ-CFG-004 (brd L246, L409; plan D13).

flows.name: CIQ Safety Finding
flows.description: Safety findings; editable by Safety only.
flows.rationale: Per-department register (brd L247, L412).

flows.name: CIQ Regulatory Finding
flows.description: Regulatory findings; editable by Regulatory only.
flows.rationale: Per-department register (brd L248, L412).

flows.name: CIQ AI Suggestion
flows.description: Marked, sourced AI suggestion that a reviewer confirms or discards.
flows.rationale: Register; confirm/discard is a field state set by SAF/REG (brd L249, REQ-PROC-024).

flows.name: CIQ Internal Note
flows.description: BDF-only chronological chat, one message per row; never visible to suppliers.
flows.rationale: Append-only register (brd L49, L250).

flows.name: CIQ Confirmation
flows.description: Every formal confirmation and decision with person, role and time; immutable by convention.
flows.rationale: Append-only register (brd L251, L416).

flows.name: CIQ Delegation
flows.description: Auditable delegation and reassignment record.
flows.rationale: Recorded fact, no approval by default (brd L252, L903).

flows.name: CIQ Audit Event
flows.description: Hash-chained business audit per case (or CONFIG).
flows.rationale: Append-only register (brd L253, L417).

flows.name: CIQ Notification Log
flows.description: Every notification event, incl. native e-mails caused by transitions.
flows.rationale: Append-only register (brd L254).

flows.name: CIQ Final Document
flows.description: Final PDF and RMES export with SHA-256 hash.
flows.rationale: Immutable record (brd L255, L779).

flows.name: CIQ Portal Link
flows.description: Idempotency ledger and job state for every airlock crossing, incl. the G4b intake lease.
flows.rationale: Ledger register (brd L256, L750-L751).

domain.summary: CIQ Digital (CIQ_Digital_A00) is the internal Beiersdorf side of the Cosmetic Ingredient Questionnaire: RMM creates a case, releases a rule-derived scope, the supplier answers in a separate portal, and only the affected departments (REG, SAF, QM, MIC, SUS, RMM) review on one CIQ Review Track each, with Safety and Regulatory recording RMES results/findings and taking final decisions. The last finishing department advances the case (G5); the supplier's final release (or RMM manual completion) and an optional overall approval end it. Configuration is versioned JSON data released four-eyes and pinned per case; registers, confirmations and a hash-chained audit make every step traceable. This domain covers 28 app flows (25 Forms + 3 Processes: CIQ Case, CIQ Review Track, CIQ Config Release; A12/A13 dropped by v2), 33 CIQ lists, 18 custom roles + Admin/User, and the §7.2 grant matrix. Part A (v2 overrides + naming contract) overrides the plan; every override and knock-on is listed in overrides_applied and runs/current/open-questions.md. The supplier portal is an external system with no app access for suppliers. Field types appear only where the source states them (contract fields, plan field lists) as quoted evidence, not as design.

business_rules.statement: Every app flow and list name starts with "CIQ " and is unique across the whole account.
No field may be named Name, Status, Type, Country, Priority, Category, Currency or Project.

Generic words are never a whole field name; References and Selects carry an owner prefix (e.g. Case_Supplier, Track_Case, Criterion_Result, Track_Decision, OP_Outcome). Avoid Supplier, Case, Result, Decision, Outcome, Dept, Reason, Country_Code.

business_rules.statement: Process step names are exact, including the en-dash "–" characters (see naming_contract).
The 15 CIQ Case contract fields keep their exact names and stated types (see naming_contract).
Long text is Textarea (never TextArea); JSON lives in Textarea.
Machine-written codes are Text; Selects only where a person picks or native reports must filter; every Select names a CIQ list that is created and populated in the same apply (no inline options).

Yes/No answers are Selects on the CIQ Yes No list, never Booleans; confirmations are a one-value Confirm Select. Exception by contract: A9 Release_Path and Overall_Approval_Required are Text "Yes"/"No".
Machine-written enumerations are Text, with no list: Applicability_Basis, Finding_Origin (Cycle_Origin and Capture_Event left with A12/A13).
Lists are append-only: never remove a value a live record uses.
Pinned configuration keys are Text, not References, so a lookup change can never re-point them.
References from CIQ Case to masters carry lookups without autofill; search mirrors are written explicitly by sessions.

business_rules.statement: Formulas use nested IF and ISBLANK; AND/OR are avoided until proven on the tenant.
Flow descriptions are at most 250 characters.
Every field not edited at Start is ReadOnly at Start; outcome and decision fields are ReadOnly at Start.
Every process has an explicit terminal End; step conditions are "=" formulas; no "Rejected" steps (native Reject and Send-back with a mandatory comment exist on every step).
A case cannot be created with a missing mandatory field (REQ-PROC-001); the UI validates every mandatory input before any write.
Case_Code is required at Start and read-only after; app-generated (e.g. CIQ-2026-0142) with a collision check on CIQ Case Index.
A case pins one published release bundle at creation (Release_Key + domain keys) and copies Manifest_Hash into Release_Hash; both read-only after Start.

Completion_Trigger is mandatory at "Awaiting supplier final release": "Supplier final release" (written by I-3) or "Manual by RMM: …" (REQ-PROC-045). Manual completion also withdraws the portal request.
Overall_Decision and Overall_Reason are read-only at Start and editable only at "Overall approval"; a reason is required on rejection.
Dept_*_Active are editable at Part 1 and Part 2; Any_Dept_Rejected and Supplier_Notice_Text are editable at Part 2.

business_rules.statement: Send-back is disabled on CIQ Case steps 2–4 (Part 2, Awaiting supplier final release, Overall approval) so integrations cannot re-fire.

Integration triggers that lead to an Approve or a create are step-specific (ItemEntersToStep / ItemExitsToStep on a named step), never ItemCompleted of a process with several paths to End (I-4 may use ItemCompleted).

Overall approval UI gate (REQ-RMES-014): Approve only when both required RMES decisions are Approved and no blocking finding or open point remains; each blocker named. In the AS-02 path only Reject is offered.

Cancellation (G8): RMM rejects the case with Cancel_Reason when RMM holds the step (steps 1–3); at "Overall approval" or for I-2-created tracks, CIQ Case Admin uses the admin route; the cascade withdraws open items and verifies no open task remains (REQ-PROC-049).
Cancelled is derived: the case is rejected AND Cancel_Reason is set. Statuses are derived (step, _status), never a custom Status select.
Reactivation = a new CIQ Case item with the same Case_Code, Current_Cycle + 1 and Reactivates_Case_Item = the old item id; default within 12 months, by RMM.

G5 is the point of no return for the cycle: the case is never sent back to Part 2; after G5 a supplier change is refused and logged or starts a new cycle. Before G5 a reopen is a NEW track with Reopen_Of_Key; ended items are never mutated.

business_rules.statement: Track_Decision is read-only at Start and mandatory at the two decision steps; a native Reject on a track is read as Track_Decision = Rejected with the comment as reason; Reject is disabled on review steps 1–6 where possible.

Department completion gate (PS-10): refuse while the department has an open point (confirmed against its portal query), a pending applicable RMES result, a negative result without a comment, or an open blocking finding; name each blocker with type, section, status and responsible person (REQ-PROC-036, -039; REQ-RMES-006, -009).
On completion: write a Department completion confirmation, set Track_Closed = Yes (departments without a decision step), submit, set the lane to Completed (Ready for decision for SAF/REG).

At the decision step: repeat the RMES gate (no pending criterion, no open blocking finding; reason mandatory on rejection), write the decision confirmation, set Track_Decision and Track_Closed, submit, lane Approved or Rejected.

G5 sync: the finishing session writes its own lane, lists the case lanes, and advances only if every activated lane is terminal (Completed; Approved/Rejected for SAF and REG), each confirmed by a direct read of its track where possible, and no open point of the case is open; it then sets Any_Dept_Rejected and, if no release will be requested, Supplier_Notice_Text, and submits Part 2. A second advance finds the step moved and stops.

Late activation (REQ-ADR-002): the reviewer session sets the department flag, writes a "Part 2 activation" scope run, creates the lane and a track with Late_Activation = Yes; reviewer roles therefore hold InitiateItems on CIQ Review Track.
Duplicate tracks per cycle (same Track_Key) are detected at intake and the later ones withdrawn.

Shared sections (K2.2, K6.14, K6.17): the lead completes; co-reviewers read and raise queries under their own department. v2: section ownership is lead-only; the co list stays in the ownership payload, read-only.
A scope run is written once and never edited; same input + same version gives the same result; Evaluator_Version is stamped (REQ-PROC-009).

Trap T1: Editable on a Process silently includes InitiateItems. Reviewers become co-initiators of tracks; the UI hides "+ New"; intake flags orphan items not created by internal users.

Trap T4/T5: Form members see and can edit all rows, and non-admins list process items only via my-items; hence listable Form read models (Case Index lanes, twins, confirmations) and "own lane" as a convention re-checked against native status.
Trap T6: grant calls may hit a 423 lock during publish; grants are applied serially with retry, then a final re-grant pass, every response checked.

Trap T7/T8: roles start empty (submit 403) and admin routes "work" for admin testers; members are verified per role before testing (people managed by Thomas) and every acceptance test runs as a non-admin user.
Trap T11: comments on portal items are visible to the supplier; internal discussion only in CIQ Internal Note.

Trap T13: any member of a step's role can act on it from Kissflow's own My Tasks, bypassing UI gates; hand-off steps are owned by the narrowest role, carry native guards (mandatory trigger fields; optional K-20/K-20b), and wait steps have e-mails off where possible.

Trap T14: applying through the engine adds baseline pages that auto-grant their roles; for the app, pages = [] and every auto-added page is deleted before the grant pass; the grant audit lists pages per role.
Trap T15: an integration re-fires when its trigger step is re-entered and Approve may complete whatever step is current; step-specific triggers and send-back disabled on trigger and hand-off steps.

inherited_hard_rules.rule: No native page, card, nav item or report may reference A19 CIQ RMES Safety Result, A20 CIQ RMES Regulatory Result, A21 CIQ Safety Finding or A22 CIQ Regulatory Finding for any role that only reads them. A page auto-grant would make that role an editor and break REQ-CFG-004. Readers of A19/A21: every role except CIQ Safety Reviewer and CIQ Safety Approver. Readers of A20/A22: every role except CIQ Regulatory Reviewer and CIQ Regulatory Approver.
inherited_hard_rules.evidence: brd L74, L657, T2, T14; security.hard_rules SEC-HR1

inherited_hard_rules.rule: Any native page or card on a flow escalates every targeted View (V) role to editor (NAV_GRANT_ESCALATION), and on a Process to initiator (LESSONS 18). Before any page work, re-check every V cell of the security matrix.

Every member of CIQ Case Sync and CIQ Case Admin must also hold CIQ RMM, a CIQ reviewer role or a CIQ approver role. The overlay roles carry only step/admin grants and rely on the base role for reading (grants are additive). Experience consequence: the overlay roles get no landing of their own; their members land through their base role.

build_requirements.requirement: Suppress the auto-added baseline experience. Use `kf build --no-pages` (the engine's build verb offers it). The dry-run build without suppression adds 20 role home pages, flow pages for A8 CIQ Config Release, A9 CIQ Case and A16 CIQ Review Track, and 4 nav menus (D32); the flow pages would turn read-only roles on those three Processes into editors and initiators.

If the generate path offers no way to suppress the baseline, delete every auto-added page and nav menu BEFORE the grant pass, then re-run the per-role grant audit (pages per role must be zero) and confirm no V role became Editable or an initiator.
The gate warning NO_PAGES is expected and accepted by design for this run (D10); it is not a defect to fix with pages.
